We trained a large language model to reason before it answers, producing a long internal chain of thought.
Through reinforcement learning the model learns to refine its thinking, try different strategies and
recognize its mistakes. Performance improves with more training compute and with more time spent thinking
at test time. The constraints on scaling this approach differ substantially from those of pretraining, and
we continue to investigate them. On competition mathematics the model places among the top students in the
country, and on a benchmark of expert science questions it exceeds human doctoral accuracy. We trained a
